A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study. Their main text, equations, figures, references, and Appendices A–D are readable and support reliable matching without material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original SFT and RL experiments on GeneralPoints and V-IRL, including generalization results, ablations, and failure analyses in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and outcomes in Section 5 and the appendices, including numerical performance comparisons and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: The SFT initialization, PPO training, verifier-based sequential revision, model inputs and outputs, and task-specific rewards remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A–C.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same language and vision-language GeneralPoints and V-IRL tasks. Coverage retains face-card rule changes, absolute versus relative navigation actions, black-to-red card transfer, and New York-to-worldwide route evaluation.

E2.justification: SFT, RL, and their shared initialization remain in the same comparisons. The previously reported V-IRL benchmark comparator is also retained; no comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: The Llama-3.2-Vision-11B backbone, data sampling, compute-matched comparisons, verification settings, and episode-success and navigation-accuracy metrics are unchanged. Appendices A–C retain the same experimental protocols.

E4.justification: Both retain analyses of visual recognition, RL without SFT, verification iterations, suboptimal SFT trajectories, learning rates and frozen components, and overfitted initialization. Figures 8–10 and 15–21 provide the same analyses and failure examples.

E5.justification: Appendix C.3 retains the same binomial standard-error calculation and uncertainty reporting. No seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence procedures, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Figure 6 retains GP-L rule-OOD scores of 15.0% for RL and 3.4% for SFT, while Figure 7 retains V-IRL visual-OOD scores of 77.8% and 11.1%. Appendix results are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains the same state, action, policy, verifier, and sequential-revision definitions. Appendix C.3 retains the computation estimates and statistical formula; no new theorem, assumption, proof, or derivation appears.

C1.justification: The abstract explicitly frames generalization around rule-based reasoning tasks. The introduction changes SFT's role in stabilizing output from 'helpful' to 'necessary,' although the conditional necessity argument already appeared in Section 5.4. The central RL-versus-SFT findings remain unchanged.

C2.justification: A new Impact Statement explicitly confines the work to controlled research settings and disclaims real-world deployment or interaction. Existing interpretations of visual-recognition degradation and limitations involving underfit or overfit initialization remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The appendices retain the same prompt examples, data construction instructions, reward specifications, hyperparameter searches, hardware information, and computation accounting. The project-page link is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and related-work discussion are retained, including positioning against prior post-training, generalization, inference-time computation, and visual-perception research. Changed citation back-reference pages reflect pagination only.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized abstract and introduction edits, adds an Impact Statement, revises affiliations and acknowledgements, and corrects some wording. The main section sequence and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 fixes the placeholder running title, updates publication formatting, and relocates existing figures, including Figures 6 and 8. Figures 13 and 14 exchange caption wording so the visual-input description accompanies the visual example. Plots and underlying figure content remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides modest clarity gains through the explicit reasoning-task scope, corrected running title, and better-matched navigation captions. Scientific evidence and reproducibility information remain unchanged. These gains are qualified by the Impact Statement's imprecise denial of real-world data interaction despite Appendix B's street-view data, and by stronger introductory SFT-necessity wording that still requires Section 5.4's backbone-specific qualification.
